question: Is the Hack Day free to attend, and can we join online instead?
answer_text: Which Hack Day are you referring to? Please share the event name or a link to its website. I can then check whether attendance is free and whether an online or virtual participation option is available.

passages.text: Hacktoberfest Hack Days must be free to attend. Participants who prefer to engage online should visit Hacktoberfest.com to see the virtual challenges and content available. Attendee registration and check-in through OrganizerHQ and post-event photos are required for both formats. All events must follow their event-specific instructions supplied after approval by the MLH Hacktoberfest team for registration, check-in, reporting, reimbursement, branding, and swag. For questions about applying or hosting, contact hacktoberfest@mlh.io.

passages.text: Get ready to innovate, build, and connect! Hacktoberfest Hack day Hamirpur x GDG Ludhiana is a high-energy, one-day in-person mini hackathon hosted at NIT Hamirpur as part of Hacktoberfest, the world’s largest celebration of open source. This year’s theme centers on open source and open-weight AI: models, tools, and agents that anyone can inspect, run, and build upon. It’s a fast-paced collaborative day where you arrive in the morning, form a team, build a small, real-world project from scratch, and demo it that same afternoon.

passages.text: Hacktoberfest Hack Days run for 3 to 12 hours, although four to six hours is ideal. Participants create and submit projects during the event for the Best Open-Source AI Project challenge. Use the MLH Standard Hackathon Rules as the default for your event: project-specific work happens during the Hack Day. If a different approach better suits your event, explain it clearly before project work begins. The challenge has one winning team, and every member receives a DEV Badge on their DEV account. Depending on availability and your event's onboarding instructions, MLH may also provide MLH+DEV branded swag bags for the winning team. The host selects the winner using the challenge guidance. Some Hacktoberfest Hack Day events will also receive a Hack Days partner prize category. These categories are assigned by the MLH Hacktoberfest team. See the partner challenge details.
